center_to_footprint_reconciliation.interpretation: The unique center association remains a contact for every square, but in 110 squares the center feature does not contain the full square. Two of those squares also overlap an adjacent source feature. This is a source-geometry relation only.

disposition.interpretation: The 10×9 footprint matrix describes geometric contact with retained source polygons. It does not establish current/legal authority, current source applicability, source-family construction intent, per-key physical qualification, native conservation, or formal disposition. The 108 partial-footprint and 2 multi-feature cells remain evidence requiring separate source/physical qualification checks.
disposition.next_evidence: Reconcile any partial or multi-feature footprint cells with the complete 33-member source construction, physical witness and target-level support. Retain native conservation and original denominator checks before any disposition.

independent_reproduction.comparison_dimensions: For every exact key: category, contact count and ordered source IDs, whole-cell containment flags, boundary-only flags, and intersection area within tolerance; per-feature totals are independently reported in the reproduction artifact.
independent_reproduction.method: Independent Python standard-library implementation directly compared with final footprint v2. Projects all source coordinates to the pinned grid, clips rings to each unit square for area (outer less holes), determines contact with closed-cell segment/vertex checks, checks all four corners against polygon outer/hole parity, and rejects whole-cell containment if any polygon ring enters the open cell interior. This covers holes, edge-only touches, and boundary crossings.

category_rules.ambiguous: Two or more source features contact the footprint, including positive-area overlap or boundary touch.
category_rules.contained: Exactly one source feature contains the whole footprint and no other feature contacts it.
category_rules.intersecting: Exactly one source feature has positive-area partial overlap or a boundary-only touch, and it does not contain the whole cell.
category_rules.zero: No source feature intersects or touches the footprint.

method.definition: Each original grid cell is the closed unit square [x,x+1] by [y,y+1] in the pinned projected grid. Polygon-cell overlap area is computed by clipping the original projected polygon rings to that square; holes are subtracted. Boundary-only touches are retained separately.

physical_reconciliation.assessment: The retained physical-support artifact is a whole-target summary across the 123 source atoms, while the accounting record identifies all 668 held cells as original class land. Neither is a per-cell overlay of these 640 grid squares against the 33 administrative source polygons. This run checked source footprints only; it did not rerun or re-fetch physical geometry.
physical_reconciliation.held_original_physical_class: land for all 668 held cells (retained accounting summary)
physical_reconciliation.limits: This source polygon footprint analysis does not substitute for the retained physical witness or prove current dry-land status. The physical artifacts were not refetched or rerun in this step.
